nfseCredentialHint: Access to the municipal provider, stored encrypted. Each fiscal environment has its own credential.
nfseCredentialTokenHint: The token field is write-only: leaving it blank does not touch what is already stored. Since saving requires the token, type it again to store any change.
nfseCredentialTokenMissing: No token configured for this environment.
nfseCredentialError: The credential could not be saved. Code: {{code}}.
nfseCredentialAbsent: No credential registered for {{environment}}. Without one, NFS-e issuance is refused.
nfseCredentialInactive: The {{environment}} credential is inactive. Until it is activated, NFS-e issuance is refused.
nfseCredentialBlockedApiTokenRequired: Type the access token to save the credential.
nfseCredentialBlockedMunicipalRegistrati: Type the provider municipal registration — it travels with every call to the city hall.
nfseCredentialBlockedTaxIdInvalid: The provider tax id must have 14 digits.
nfseProfileHint: Each profile binds a freight rule to the data the city hall requires on the service invoice.

nfseProfileError: The profile could not be saved. Code: {{code}}.
nfseProfileBlockedFreightRuleRequired: Choose the freight rule that calculates the service amount.
nfseProfileBlockedMunicipalityInvalid: Type the municipality name and the 7-digit IBGE code.
